authority: official repository source, not REA-proven deployed core behavior

findings.observed: AllOfResource plans requests across all installed descriptors whose advertised resource/type/id-prefix accepts the requested ID; catalog enumeration is a separate plan.
findings.recommendation: Plan Fotty discovery from a verified canonical fixture independently for each reviewed eligible adapter. A closed master catalog must not determine whether CS/AS can be asked. Preserve explicit provider-event binding rather than sending Fotty IDs into addon namespaces.
findings.limit: Stremio relies on common ID namespaces and first metadata choices; it does not implement sports teams/date/squad correctness.

findings.observed: Meta defaultVideoId wins; otherwise suitable video/channel identity supplies stream_path. Embedded meta streams and separately requested streams are tracked with provenance request base/path; transport percent-encodes exact resource/type/ID.
findings.recommendation: Retain an immutable EventBinding from verified fixture through provider event/meta to advertised streamID/type, recording date/squad/competition/format evidence and manifest revision. Refresh/rebind on conflict; never reconstruct stream IDs from display titles or substitute a generic channel.
findings.limit: Generic live-channel support cannot corroborate the current sports programme.

findings.mechanism: Per-resource outcomes and explicit cache bypass
findings.observed: Each request carries Loading/Ready/typed Error; parallel effect updates only matching request. A force_request primitive bypasses cached content, including errors. However streams_update uses force:false.
findings.recommendation: Keep Fotty's append-only18s fanout. Give positive and empty stream results independent bounded freshness; explicit retry of a now-live exact event must bypass a stale negative response. Test empty-before-kickoff→published-later without app restart.
findings.limit: Cannot claim current Stremio core automatically refreshes late-published stream lists; the inspected stream updater does not force refresh.

findings.mechanism: Background schedule refresh preserves playable source state
findings.observed: Live schedule refresh uses a separate request, leaves displayed channel and streams intact, suppresses overlapping refresh, waits15min normally or1min after coverage expiry/error. Tests assert streams unchanged after refresh/retry.
findings.recommendation: Refresh sports/provider metadata separately from active playback and last accepted confirmed binding. Keep an admitted playing source during catalogue outage; mark catalogue freshness without erasing playback or silently accepting conflicting data.
findings.limit: EPG refresh interval is not a stream descriptor expiry policy; do not copy channel behavior to infer a fixture is on a channel.

findings.mechanism: Last-good preference is revalidated against a current response
findings.observed: Remembered stream must be present in current resource output with same addon transport, then source match or binge match; stored URL alone is not returned.
findings.recommendation: Keep decoded-start ranking/preferences, but resolve a fresh matching descriptor before using expired/provider-revised sessions. Preserve exact fixture binding and required headers/lease expiry.
findings.limit: Binge grouping belongs to episodic content; do not port it as a sports identity heuristic.

proposedFottyFlow: Current stream descriptor(s), independent per provider

availabilityDistinctions.scheduled: authoritative fixture only; not promise of a stream
availabilityDistinctions.discovered: fresh exact provider binding plus compatible stream candidate; not playback proof
availabilityDistinctions.decoded: current native advancing programme evidence, scoped and timestamped

priority: Proactively refresh bounded descriptors for owner-relevant approaching/live critical fixtures; retry late-published emptiness; do not solve dead ends only by hiding Watch.
